definition: Actual spend assigned to a valid Spend Category for which no element of that Budget Actual's frozen Spend Category ancestry carries a Category Budget Entry in the selected Budget Plan Revision. Spend on an unplanned Spend Category whose ancestry does carry a nearer entry is not Unbudgeted Spend; DD-BUDGET-CATEGORY-ENVELOPE-RESOLUTION assigns it to that nearest entry. Avoid: unplanned spend, uncategorized spend.
